name: naija-grid
title: NERC monthly energy caps and service bands for every Nigerian feeder, 2022 to 2026
description: Feeder-level monthly energy caps for unmetered customers and service bands A to E, from every Monthly Energy Cap order the Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission has published online (Order NERC/307/2022), linked across months.

fields.name: feeder_id
fields.description: Stable id for a feeder across months (12 hex characters). Links the same feeder through renames.

fields.name: disco
fields.description: Distribution company code: AEDC Abuja, BEDC Benin, EEDC Enugu, EKEDC Eko, IBEDC Ibadan, IKEDC Ikeja, JEDC Jos, KAEDC Kaduna, KEDCO Kano, PHED Port Harcourt, YEDC Yola, APLE Aba Power.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Nigerian state of the feeder (36 states plus FCT), UNKNOWN when it could not be established.

fields.name: order_month
fields.description: Month of the NERC order (YYYY-MM). The cap applies to bills for this month.

fields.name: consumption_month
fields.description: Month whose consumption the cap covers: the month before order_month, as stated in each order's title.

fields.name: band
fields.description: Service band A to E. A promises at least 20 hours of supply a day; E the least. '?' only in data/parsed, where a scanned band letter could not be read.

fields.name: cap_kwh
fields.description: Maximum kWh a DisCo may bill an unmetered non-MD customer on this feeder for the month (Order NERC/307/2022).

fields.name: state_source
fields.description: Where state comes from: printed (in the order), learned (from the same business unit in later orders), manual (data/reference/bu_state_manual.csv), unknown.

fields.name: extraction_method
fields.description: text (PDF text layer) or ocr (scanned page read with Apple Vision; text in raw/ocr_text).

fields.name: id_link
fields.description: How the row was linked to its feeder: exact, fuzzy_ocr (scanned name matched to a text-month feeder at similarity 0.88 or more), fuzzy_ocr_conflict (a second scanned row matched the same feeder in the same month; kept as its own id).

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: File name of the NERC PDF in raw/pdfs.

fields.name: source_page
fields.description: Page of the PDF the row is on (1-based).

fields.name: regulator
fields.description: Who set the cap: NERC, LASERC (Lagos) or EERC (Enugu).

fields.name: band_source
fields.description: printed, carried_from_nerc_YYYY-MM (Enugu: last NERC band) or not_published.

fields.name: tariff_naira_per_kwh
fields.description: Allowed Non-MD tariff for the band and month (naira per kWh).

fields.name: max_bill_naira
fields.description: cap_kwh x tariff x 1.075 (VAT), rounded: the most an unmetered non-MD customer can legally be billed.

fields.name: tariff_source
fields.description: Tariff order the rate comes from.
